annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministry of Science and ICT (MSIT), Republic of Korea
key_provisions_or_claims: Committee chaired by the President deliberates and coordinates national AI policy and monitors implementation.
Eight private-sector subcommittees cover technology, industry, public sector, data, society, international cooperation, talent, and defense & security.
Council of Chief AI Officers formed from vice-minister-level officials for inter-ministerial execution.
Korea AI Action Plan has three pillars and twelve domains, aiming for global top three in AI.
Committee briefed on approach to subordinate legislation under the AI Basic Act and the National AI Computing Center plan.
annotation.summary_en: MSIT press release announcing the launch of Korea's presidential National AI Strategy Committee on 8 September 2025. It describes the committee's mandate, eight subcommittees, the Council of Chief AI Officers, the Korea AI Action Plan aiming for a global top-three AI position, the National AI Computing Center, and subordinate legislation under the AI Basic Act.
annotation.title_clean: National AI Strategy Committee Launched as Korea's Top-Level AI Policy Body
